name: tou_away_bank_writes_once_1395
description: Issue #1395 (the Away mirror of #1393): the house is Away on a hot day with a 16:15 peak. A cycle inside the pre-cool window used to tell the thermostat the 82 F setback band and then the split-delta bank target in the same second; it now tells it the bank target once.

assertions.reason: First cycle inside the Away pre-cool window: the bank target once, no setback band first (issue #1395).
Between cycles nothing is written: the bank write no longer schedules a 5-minute follow-up that re-sends it (issue #1395).
A later cycle inside the window re-asserts the bank target once (issue #1395).

verdict.summary: While pre-cooling an Away house for a peak, each cycle tells the thermostat the bank target once
verdict.observed_behavior: One set_temperature per cycle (the split-delta target); before the fix the 82 F setback band came first in the same second.
verdict.expected_behavior: Occupant view: no brief flick to the setback value, and one cloud write per check instead of two.
